description: Type of constraint (e.g. "primary energy", "tech_capacity_expansion_limit", "operational_limit", "transmission_volume_expansion_limit", "transmission_expansion_cost_limit", "flow_based"). A `flow_based` row stores its zonal PTDF as one attribute `ptdf_<zone>` per zone (static or series), where the zone is a bus or a corridor link.

Investment period for which the constraint is applied. If not specified, the constraint is applied to all investment periods together. For `type="flow_based"`, the period in whose snapshots the CNEC applies (default: all).
Bus to which the global constraint applies. Only relevant for `type="tech_expansion_limit". If not specified, the constraint applies to all buses.
If the global constraint is connected with a carrier, name the associated carrier attribute. This must appear as a column in `n.carriers`.
Constraint sense; must be one of <=, == or >=
Constant for right-hand-side of constraint for optimisation period. For a CO~2~ constraint, this would be tonnes of CO~2~. Time-varying only for `type="flow_based"` (the RAM).
Shadow price of global constraint; per snapshot for `type="flow_based"`.
